items.title: Stop publishing a Cloudflare bot challenge as an outage on /status/
items.why: The public availability surface has reported edge-degraded for 100% of the 1488 retained samples since 2026-07-13. Visitors reading /status/ are told our own edge is degraded while it is serving them fine, which is a CANON-031 observability-honesty failure on a public trust surface.
items.recipe: Give the liveness, workerIngest and rumIngestPost legs the same challenge-shape classification the login leg already has: a CF challenge is UNOBSERVABLE from CI, not an outage. Never convert unobservable to ok:true — publish observable:false, exclude unobserved rows from rollup denominators, and let overall report edge-unobservable rather than edge-degraded or a fake up.

evidence.interpretation: Probed live during the audit: GET https://vaultsparkstudios.com/api/founder-presence.json returns 200 application/json from a residential IP and 403 at 127ms from CI. The file header asserts "JSON/API paths are not bot-challenged" - that premise expired when Cloudflare widened challenges to JSON paths.
evidence.limitations: Residential-vs-CI asymmetry is the diagnosis; it does not by itself prove the edge is healthy, which is exactly why the fix must publish unobservable rather than up.

items.title: Observe the edge from inside the edge: Worker scheduled() sampler with bounded KV
items.why: Edge liveness is structurally unobservable from GitHub Actions because every datacenter request to the apex is challenged. A Cloudflare cron runs inside Cloudflare, so it can observe apex health without passing a challenge - it is the only way to make item 1 report a real green instead of an honest unobservable.
items.recipe: Add scheduled() to the production worker behind UPTIME_SAMPLER_ENABLED (default 0, so a deploy changes nothing), write bounded fixed-key KV samples with TTL, and add a drain script that folds samples into the unchanged uptime history contract. Rollback is a flag flip, not a redeploy.

premises.claim: The production worker has no scheduled handler.

evidence.interpretation: Genius list rank 1 (score 100) and the recorded nextMilestone. Shipping it dark this session keeps the trust-path release independent, as the task text requires.
evidence.limitations: The flag stays 0 this session; enabling it is a separate release with its own rollback evidence. A KV write per request is what exhausted free quota before, so the schema is one fixed key per sample window with TTL, never per-request.

items.title: check-secrets must consult the disproof it already holds
items.why: The gateway prints READY for a capability whose own CAPABILITY_MAP entry records lastProbeStatus auth-error. This is the surface an agent checks before declaring itself blocked (CANON-019), so a false READY sends the next session down a dead path.
items.recipe: Read lastProbeStatus alongside presence and report a third state - present-but-failing - instead of collapsing it into READY. Presence is not scope.

evidence.interpretation: Recorded as an open S344 OBS/P1 item; the script is local to this repo so the fix is in scope here.
evidence.limitations: The CAPABILITY_MAP itself is studio-ops owned; only the reader is fixed here.
